title: Determination of the Angular Momentum of Radiated Gravitons, Scalars, and Dark Photons from Binary Orbits
summary: We compute the energy and angular momentum radiated by compact binaries through gravitational waves, scalar and vector fields, using the field-theoretic approach. We observe that each emitted graviton carries away an angular momentum of $\dot{J}/\dot {N}\simeq 2\hbar$, not only for elliptical orbits (as has already been pointed out by Page [arXiv:2409.00305]) but also for hyperbolic orbits. We extend the analysis to scalar and vector radiation and find that the angular momentum carried by each emitted quantum of radiation is approximately $\hbar$, i.e., $\dot{J}/\dot{N}\simeq \hbar$ for both…
